design.title: Ring pooling: the place description keeps WHERE in the frame things are (centre / middle ring / edge), not one average over the whole 128 m frame
design.init_strategy: pretrained:mobilenet_v2 IMAGENET1K_V1 features[0..17] (torchvision, BSD-3), unchanged from experiment 16
design.eli5: Until now each navigator described a photo by tipping all its little observations into one bag - 'there are flat roofs, some trees, a wide road' - without saying where in the picture they were. A new survey changes many of those observations (leaves, shadows, parked cars) but not the layout of the city. Now the navigator keeps three bags instead of one: what is right underneath, what is in a ring around that, and what is at the edge. That still works whichever way the drone is facing, but it describes the arrangement of the place, which stays the same from one photograph to the next.
design.hypothesis: Experiments 12-16 took held-out truedop_2024 from 10.75% to 86.75% usable (exp 16: mission 0.155, usable 0.8675, false fix 0.0225, abstain 0.11) by improving only the trunk, and the three training photographs now sit at 100% usable / 0% false fix on the same held-out viewpoints, so what is left is purely the survey gap. One stage has never been questioned in the whole era: every member's place feature is a GLOBAL AVERAGE (GAP) of its 14x14 and 7x7 trunk maps. GAP is an orderless bag of local features: it says WHICH roofs, trees, road surfaces and shadows are in the 128 m frame, but not where. That is exactly the part of the description that a new survey corrupts (season changes canopy, sun angle changes shadows, cars and construction differ), while the part a new survey preserves - the spatial arrangement of buildings, streets and blocks relative to the point the aircraft is over - is thrown away. GAP was the natural choice because frames arrive at arbitrary headings and an average is rotation-invariant; but rotation invariance does not need orderlessness. Concentric-ring pooling (mean over the centre disc, the middle annulus and the outer ring, separately, then concatenated) is equally invariant to heading about the frame centre and keeps the radial layout: 'a courtyard under me, a block of flat roofs around it, a wide road at the edge' instead of 'some courtyard, some roofs, some road'. The frame centre is by construction the labelled position (training views are rotated about the crop centre, eval error is measured at the crop centre), so the centre ring in particular carries the most position-specific content, and neighbouring cells that share the same bag of textures but differ in arrangement become separable. I expect this to (a) convert part of the 11% abstentions, which on this design are frames where the two members or the 3x3 block split their belief between look-alike places, into confident correct fixes, and (b) not raise false fixes, since the confidence gate is unchanged. Builds on the experiment 12-16 lineage (trunk, committee, cosine head and MixStyle all kept as-is); no earlier-era experiment changed the pooling of a pretrained trunk, so this is new on any ruler.
